correctness.rationale: For b*Delta(a,b) nonzero over algebraic closure F17, y²=x Q(x³), Q=t³+t²+at+b, has genus4. The Cartier operator has a sparse 4x4 matrix with independent blocks: scalar B=[t^8]Q^8 and two disjoint vector blocks (A,E) and (C,D), so rank=1_{B!=0}+1_{(A,E)!=0}+1_{(C,D)!=0}. Independently expanded Q^8 over F17 and checked A=b^6(8b-6a²), E=-2a²+5ab+8a-2b+5. Substituting b=5a² solves (A,E)=0 at three points (4,12),(10,7),(13,12), which have nonzero discriminant. Exact symbolic resultant Res_b(C,D)=3a³(a-6)^12(a+4)(a+7)(a-4) and specialized gcds at a=0,6,13,10,4 rule out other common zeros even in algebraic closure: (0,0) excludes b=0, (6,12) singular. Evaluating B yields rank0 at (13,12) -> a=4, rank1 at other two -> a=3, rank2 when B=0 elsewhere -> a=2, rank3 otherwise -> a=1. The resultant and gcd computations, not a prime-field census, justify completeness over all algebraic extensions.
